title: I built a reputation as a ‘walker’ so I could cheat when it mattered most – and it worked | The Secret Cricket Coach
summary: Cricket always celebrates sportsmanship and condemns cheating, but where exactly is the line between the two? I once played in a one-day semi-final. We were in a very tight spot when I edged the ball to the keeper. I didn’t walk. The opposition couldn’t believe it. They crowded around me, furious, and I was getting plenty of abuse. I managed to get a single and when I reached the other end the umpire said: “You didn’t nick that did you? You are a walker.” “Yep, that’s right,” I replied. Continue reading...
